name: banking_routing_intents
instructions: What is this digital-bank customer's support message mainly about? Pick the most specific matching topic.

criteria.activate_my_card: how to activate a newly received card
criteria.card_about_to_expire: card is expiring soon / replacing an expiring card
criteria.card_acceptance: where the card is accepted (shops, merchants)
criteria.card_arrival: ordered card has not arrived yet / tracking card delivery
criteria.card_linking: adding / linking a card to the app, or reactivating a card I thought was lost but found again
criteria.card_not_working: physical card not working at all
criteria.card_swallowed: ATM kept / swallowed / took my card
criteria.change_pin: how or where to change / reset / update my existing card PIN to a new one
criteria.pin_not_received: I don't have / can't find / don't know my card's PIN yet; how and when the PIN is delivered or set up for a new card
criteria.declined_card_payment: card was refused / declined when trying to pay at a shop or online
criteria.disposable_card_limits: limits on disposable virtual cards (how many uses, how many cards)
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: how to get a disposable (single-use) virtual card
criteria.get_physical_card: how to get a physical card and whether it costs anything; where to find / receive the card PIN
criteria.getting_spare_card: getting an extra / additional / second card
criteria.getting_virtual_card: how to get a virtual card
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: virtual or disposable card not working / rejected
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: whether the bank's OWN issued card is Visa or Mastercard, or asking to be issued one brand instead of the other
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: using Apple Pay or Google Pay
criteria.atm_support: which ATMs can be used / ATM availability
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN is blocked / locked after wrong attempts
criteria.pending_card_payment: a card purchase is still showing as pending / not completed
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: ATM cash withdrawal still showing as pending
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: which card brands (Visa, Mastercard, Amex) or currencies are accepted for adding money / topping up or paying; e.g. 'Can I use a Visa or Mastercard?', 'what type of card can I use to top up?'
criteria.compromised_card: card details or PIN may have been compromised / stolen / used by someone else
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: card lost or stolen, need to block it
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: phone lost or stolen, protecting the app/account
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: card payment on statement I don't recognise / didn't make
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: cash withdrawal I didn't make / don't recognise
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: direct debit I don't recognise / didn't set up
criteria.passcode_forgotten: forgot app passcode / can't log into the app
criteria.request_refund: asking for a refund for a purchase
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: refund from merchant not showing up in the account
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: duplicate charge, charged twice for one purchase
criteria.reverted_card_payment: a card payment that went through was later cancelled, reversed or returned to the account
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: ATM gave the wrong amount of cash / less than requested
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: an unexplained small extra amount (e.g. an extra £1) on a transaction or statement
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: a bank transfer INTO my account has been made/sent but my balance has not updated yet
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: cheque or cash deposit not showing in balance
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: can't add a beneficiary / payee not allowed
criteria.cancel_transfer: cancel or reverse a transfer I made, or sent money to the wrong account
criteria.receiving_money: how to receive money or salary into the account (including in other currencies), and whether receiving has fees
criteria.transfer_into_account: how to transfer money into my account
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: money I sent has not arrived at the recipient, or they received less
criteria.transfer_timing: how long transfers take to arrive
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: topping up with cash or cheque
criteria.topping_up_by_card: how to top up / add money using a card (the process), or top-up by card not working
criteria.verify_top_up: verifying a top-up / card verification code for top-up
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: a fee was applied to a card payment/purchase
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: wrong exchange rate applied to a card payment abroad
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: fee charged for ATM cash withdrawal
criteria.exchange_via_app: how to exchange currencies in the app
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: fee for topping up by bank transfer
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: fee for topping up by card
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: wrong exchange rate on ATM withdrawal abroad
criteria.age_limit: minimum age to open an account
criteria.country_support: which countries the service/accounts/cards are available in
criteria.edit_personal_details: change name, address or personal details
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: identity verification failing / app can't recognise me
criteria.verify_my_identity: how to verify identity, documents needed
